3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.author: Olivia Miller
3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.reviewBody: Our 3-day Casablanca to Merzouga desert tour was an unforgettable experience. The first day through Meknes and Midelt gave us a chance to see a completely different side of Morocco before reaching the Sahara. We especially loved the views over the Ziz Valley, the camel trek across Erg Chebbi at sunset and the peaceful night in the desert camp. It was a fast trip, but very well organized and perfect for the limited time we had in Morocco.

3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.author: James Anderson
3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.reviewBody: We started our desert tour from Rabat and really enjoyed the route through Meknes, Midelt and the Ziz Valley. The scenery changed so much during the journey, from green countryside to mountains, palm groves and finally the Sahara. Arriving in Merzouga and riding camels into the Erg Chebbi dunes was the highlight. The sunset, dinner and local music at the desert camp made the long drive completely worth it.

3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.author: Sophie Martin
3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.reviewBody: This three-day Morocco desert tour from Casablanca was a great choice for us because we wanted to see the Sahara but did not have many days available. We enjoyed the stop in Meknes, the overnight stay in Midelt and the beautiful Ziz Valley on the way to Merzouga. Camel trekking at sunset and waking early for sunrise over Erg Chebbi were incredible experiences. Our driver made the long road days comfortable with regular stops.

3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.author: Daniel Williams
3-day-tour-from-casablanca-rabat-to-the-.reviewBody: A fantastic short Sahara adventure from Casablanca. The route was long but full of changing scenery, and we liked having the first night in Midelt before continuing through the Ziz Valley to Merzouga. The camel ride across the golden dunes, Sahara sunset and overnight camp were easily the best parts of the tour. The return through Midelt and Kasbah Tadla was a long day, but everything was handled smoothly.

3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.author: Olivia Miller
3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.reviewBody: Our 3-day Marrakech to Merzouga desert tour was one of the best experiences of our Morocco trip. We loved crossing the High Atlas Mountains, visiting Ait Ben Haddou and Ouarzazazate, and exploring the Dades Valley. The camel trek into the Erg Chebbi dunes at sunset was unforgettable, and the desert camp was a beautiful way to experience the Sahara.

3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.author: James Anderson
3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.reviewBody: A fantastic Marrakech to Merzouga tour from beginning to end. Our driver was friendly and knowledgeable, and we enjoyed the stops at Ait Ben Haddou and Todra Gorge. The highlight was arriving in Merzouga, riding camels across the golden Erg Chebbi dunes, watching the Sahara sunset, and spending the night in the desert camp.

3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.author: Sophie Martin
3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.reviewBody: We highly recommend this 3-day Morocco desert tour from Marrakech. The journey through the Atlas Mountains, Dades Valley, Todra Gorge, and southern Morocco was beautiful. Everything was well organized, from the comfortable transportation and hotel in Dades to the camel trekking experience and overnight stay in the Sahara Desert.

3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.author: Daniel Williams
3-days-desert-tour-from-marrakech-to-mer.reviewBody: This was an amazing way to experience the Sahara Desert in a short time. The 3-day Marrakech to Merzouga itinerary included incredible landscapes, Ait Ben Haddou, Ouarzazate, Todra Gorge, and the beautiful Erg Chebbi dunes. The camel ride at sunset and sunrise in the desert were unforgettable. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Morocco.

3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.author: Olivia Miller
3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.reviewBody: A perfect short desert trip from Errachidia. The Ziz Valley was beautiful on the way to Merzouga, and having a full day for Khamlia and the Sahara made the trip feel complete. The camel trek and camp under the stars were unforgettable.

3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.author: James Anderson
3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.reviewBody: Starting in Errachidia saved a lot of driving time. We reached Merzouga quickly, explored the desert properly on day two and still had time for Rissani and the Ziz Valley before returning to the airport.

3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.author: Sophie Martin
3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.reviewBody: This three-day Errachidia to Merzouga itinerary was simple and well balanced. We loved Khamlia, the desert excursion, sunset camel trek and sunrise over Erg Chebbi.

3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.author: Daniel Williams
3-days-from-errachidia-to-merzouga.reviewBody: A great option if you are flying into Errachidia and mainly want the Sahara. The palm groves, Merzouga, Khamlia, camel ride and camp all fit comfortably into three days.

3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: Olivia Miller
3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: Our 3-day Fes to Merzouga desert tour via Erfoud was a wonderful way to experience the changing landscapes of Morocco. We enjoyed the drive through Ifrane and Midelt, and the views over the Ziz Valley were beautiful. Spending the first night in Erfoud made the journey comfortable, and the camel trek across the Erg Chebbi dunes at sunset was unforgettable. The desert camp was peaceful, the dinner was good, and waking up for sunrise over the Sahara was one of our favorite moments in Morocco.

3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: James Anderson
3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: A fantastic desert tour from Fes from beginning to end. The route through the Middle Atlas, Midelt and the Ziz Valley was very scenic, and we really liked stopping in Erfoud before continuing to Rissani and Merzouga. Our driver made the long journey easy with regular stops. Riding camels into Erg Chebbi while the sun was setting was the highlight, followed by a relaxing evening with music at the Sahara desert camp.

3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: Sophie Martin
3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: We highly recommend this 3-day Fes to Merzouga tour via Erfoud. It was a great mix of mountain scenery, oasis landscapes and the Sahara Desert. We loved seeing the palm groves of the Ziz Valley, learning about the fossil region around Erfoud and visiting Rissani before reaching Merzouga. The camel ride, sunset over the dunes and overnight stay in the desert camp made the trip very special.

3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: Daniel Williams
3-days-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: This was an excellent short Sahara tour from Fes. The first day to Erfoud was long but full of interesting scenery, especially around Ifrane, Midelt and the Ziz Valley. The second day was more relaxed and gave us time to enjoy Erfoud, Rissani and Merzouga before the camel trek. Watching the sunset and sunrise over Erg Chebbi and spending the night in the desert camp were experiences we will always remember.

3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.author: Olivia Miller
3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.reviewBody: A very easy plan for three days in Marrakech. The first day helped us understand the medina, the guided cultural day gave us more context and the final day trip was a great change from the busy city.

3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.author: James Anderson
3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.reviewBody: We liked the balance of city time and one day outside Marrakech. The souks and Jemaa el-Fnaa were lively, and the cultural visit made the history much easier to understand. The day trip option made the itinerary feel more complete.

3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.author: Sophie Martin
3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.reviewBody: This was a simple Marrakech itinerary that did not feel rushed. We had time for markets, historic places, food and free time, then finished with a day trip for nature and fresh air.

3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.author: Daniel Williams
3-days-in-marrakech-a-simple-and-fun-pla.reviewBody: A useful three-day plan for first-time visitors. The medina and cultural day were interesting, and having a flexible third-day choice between Ouzoud, Ourika and Essaouira worked well.

3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: Olivia Miller
3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: Our 3-day Fes to Merzouga desert tour was one of the highlights of our Morocco trip. The drive through Ifrane, the Middle Atlas and Midelt was beautiful, and the views around the Ziz Valley were incredible. Reaching Merzouga on the first day gave us more time to enjoy the desert on day two. We loved visiting Khamlia, riding camels across the Erg Chebbi dunes at sunset and spending the night in the Sahara camp under a sky full of stars.

3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: James Anderson
3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: A fantastic Fes to Merzouga tour from beginning to end. The route was long on the first day, but the stops in Ifrane, Midelt and the Ziz region made the journey interesting. We really enjoyed having a full second day around Merzouga instead of leaving the desert immediately. Khamlia, the camel trek, Sahara sunset and the overnight desert camp were all memorable experiences.

3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: Sophie Martin
3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: We highly recommend this 3-day Fes to Merzouga desert tour. The landscapes changed completely during the journey, from the green Middle Atlas to the dry valleys and finally the golden Erg Chebbi dunes. We enjoyed learning more about the Merzouga area and Gnawa music in Khamlia before the camel ride. Watching the sunset over the dunes and sleeping in the Sahara camp made the trip very special.

3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.author: Daniel Williams
3-days-tour-from-fes-to-merzouga-desert.reviewBody: This was a great way to experience the Sahara from Fes in only three days. Our favorite part was having a full desert day in Merzouga before the overnight camp. The camel trek across Erg Chebbi at sunset was amazing, and sunrise the next morning was just as beautiful. The return drive through Midelt and the Middle Atlas was long, but everything was well organized and the stops made the journey comfortable.

4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.author: Olivia Miller
4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.reviewBody: Our 4-day Casablanca to Merzouga and Imilchil tour was one of the most varied trips we experienced in Morocco. We enjoyed the stop in Meknes, the mountain scenery around Midelt and the beautiful views over the Ziz Valley before reaching Erfoud and Merzouga. The camel trek across Erg Chebbi at sunset and the night in the Sahara camp were unforgettable, and continuing through Todra Gorge to Imilchil gave the trip a completely different High Atlas atmosphere.

4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.author: James Anderson
4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.reviewBody: A fantastic four-day Morocco road trip from Casablanca. The route through Meknes, Midelt, the Ziz Valley and Erfoud was very scenic, and reaching Merzouga for the camel ride and desert camp was the highlight. We also really liked the third day because Todra Gorge and the road toward Imilchil were very different from the Sahara. The changing landscapes made this tour feel much richer than a simple desert transfer.

4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.author: Sophie Martin
4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.reviewBody: We highly recommend this 4-day Casablanca desert tour for travelers who want to see both the Sahara and the High Atlas. The palm groves of the Ziz Valley, Erfoud, Merzouga and Erg Chebbi were beautiful, and the sunset camel trek was a special experience. After the desert, walking through Todra Gorge and spending the night in Imilchil made the itinerary feel very complete and different from the usual Morocco desert route.

4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.author: Daniel Williams
4-days-itinerary-tour-from-casablanca.reviewBody: This was an excellent way to travel from Casablanca to the Sahara while also seeing a quieter part of the High Atlas. We loved the drive through Midelt and the Ziz Valley, the camel trek in Erg Chebbi, sunset over the dunes and the overnight desert camp. Todra Gorge and Imilchil were also highlights, and the final journey through Kasbah Tadla back to Casablanca showed us another side of central Morocco.

4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.author: Olivia Miller
4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.reviewBody: A lovely short Morocco itinerary. Marrakech was lively, Imlil was peaceful and the High Atlas scenery was beautiful. Walking around Ait Ben Haddou was a highlight, and the return through Ouarzazate gave us another look at southern Morocco before going back to Marrakech.

4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.author: James Anderson
4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.reviewBody: This four-day route had a great mix of city and mountain scenery. We especially enjoyed the night in Imlil and the drive through the High Atlas. Ait Ben Haddou was impressive and the final stop in Ouarzazate made the last day interesting without feeling rushed.

4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.author: Sophie Martin
4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.reviewBody: The itinerary was simple but varied. We had time in Marrakech, then a completely different atmosphere in Imlil. The mountain villages and Ait Ben Haddou were beautiful, and the trip back to Marrakech through Ouarzazate was very scenic.

4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.author: Daniel Williams
4-days-tour-from-marrakech-to-merzouga.reviewBody: A good choice for travelers who want Marrakech, the High Atlas and Ait Ben Haddou in only four days. The views around Imlil were excellent and the historic ksar at Ait Ben Haddou was one of our favorite places.

morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.author: Olivia Miller
morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.reviewBody: Our 10-day Morocco itinerary from Marrakech was an amazing way to see so many different parts of the country. We loved exploring Marrakech, spending time in Imlil and crossing the High Atlas before visiting Ait Ben Haddou. The route through Ouarzazate, the Draa Valley and Zagora was beautiful, and the camel trek into the Merzouga desert at sunset was unforgettable. Todra Gorge, Dades Valley, Rose Valley and Ouzoud Waterfalls made the journey feel very complete.

morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.author: James Anderson
morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.reviewBody: A fantastic 10-day Morocco tour from Marrakech from start to finish. The itinerary had a great balance of cities, mountains, villages, desert and nature. We especially enjoyed Imlil, Ait Ben Haddou, the Draa Valley and the road to Merzouga. Riding camels across Erg Chebbi, watching the Sahara sunset and sleeping in the desert camp were highlights, and finishing the trip with Todra Gorge, Dades Valley and Ouzoud Waterfalls was perfect.

morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.author: Sophie Martin
morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.reviewBody: We highly recommend this Morocco itinerary for anyone who wants to see more than just Marrakech and the Sahara. Every day felt different, from the High Atlas Mountains and Imlil to Ait Ben Haddou, Zagora, Merzouga, Tinghir and the beautiful valleys in the south. The desert camp in Erg Chebbi was very special, and we also loved the walk through Todra Gorge and the visit to Ouzoud Waterfalls before returning to Marrakech.

morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.author: Daniel Williams
morocco-itinerary-10-days-from-marrakech.reviewBody: This 10-day private Morocco tour gave us a wonderful mix of culture, scenery and adventure. We enjoyed Marrakech, the mountain atmosphere in Imlil, the historic ksar of Ait Ben Haddou and the long drive through the Draa Valley toward Zagora and Merzouga. The camel trek and night in the Sahara were unforgettable, but Todra Gorge, Dades Valley, Rose Valley and Ouzoud Waterfalls were also beautiful. It was a very memorable Morocco road trip.
